claims.claim: Later sleep timing was linked to lower morning alertness.
claims.quote: Later sleep timing predicted lower alertness, t(48) = 2.10, p = .041.

claims.claim: Alertness recovered after a fixed wake time.
claims.quote: Alertness recovered after fixed wake times, t(22) = 2.30, p < .05.

claims.claim: The alertness scale has been validated in adults.
claims.quote: The alertness scale has been validated in adults [31].

claims.claim: Sleep timing varies with season in this region.
claims.quote: Seasonal variation in sleep timing was reported earlier [32].

claims.claim: The recruitment approach follows earlier work.
claims.quote: Recruitment followed the approach used in earlier work [33].
